'''Harcen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Harcen dispatched [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to a conclave of rebel sympathizers on [[Kiamurr]].
